No text, lettering, captions, logos, signatures, frame, UI, split panels or collage. This is an original Encore simulation tableau, not a canonical event from the series, no cure, no reversion, no recovered identity, no invented memory. Exactly ONE complete identifiable creature, entirely visible with generous safe margins and grounded convincingly in the supplied real stage. The FIRST supplied reference is the sole character design authority. Preserve its non-humanoid topology, proportions, face/eye distribution and exact palette, legs/feet or tendrils, spikes and outline. Do not replace it with a humanoid, rabbit, chess figure, frog, costume or generic monster. Do not merge it with background eyes, duplicate it, add other characters, audience figures, people, distant silhouettes or reflections that read as a second character. Remaining references are the stage far/mid/near planes; preserve their specific geometric architecture and visual identity. Use a new composition, not a pasted sprite screenshot. Integrate the source character in hand-painted 2D scene lighting while retaining its identity.

CHARACTER LOCK: the source is a tall black crystalline four-legged abstraction, not a chess piece. A narrow elevated asymmetrical neck/spire points upper right, several sharp branching side spires give a jagged crownlike contour, but there is NO literal crown. Splayed limbs end in long pointed separated talons. Iridescent violet, magenta, cyan and yellow highlights on black facets; embedded almond eyes with slit pupils in reference palette/positions, mostly magenta/cyan/yellow with one red. Preserve this silhouette; no calm replacement, no chess body.

STAGE LOCK: Abstraction Threshold, a deep dark crystalline cavern: enormous inward curling jagged rock arches framing left/right with luminous cyan inside facets and purple cracks; a large descending jagged central rock mass; small flat-topped floating stone islands receding into turquoise low mist; flat blue-violet fractured stone floor with purple fault lines. Tiny cyan/magenta/yellow eye motifs in the black upper void remain abstract background motifs, not creatures. Keep this architecture recognizable; no circus theater, curtains, buildings, ocean or new location.

NARRATIVE: Encore presents abstracted Queenie in a simulation; the calm state is an appearance of the same fighter and no reversion is proposed. Use the given active stance unchanged. COMPOSITION: creature full-body centered slightly right, on a broad flat foreground stone slab, four pointed feet and all branching spikes visible. A narrow existing purple fracture runs between its feet and the cyan-lit space at left. The cavern's central descending mass frames the creature from above without tangent contact. Restrained light held at a clear distance, fine cyan edge light; body stays black, all eye colors as supplied. No lantern-holding person, no chess objects.

OUTPUT: one single finished landscape 16:9 image, opaque background, no sheet, no border. Preserve the full shape, never crop a foot, tip, tendril or spike.
